summary: Iteration 5: tested the Slack routing API and UI, drift alerts, nudge routing fields, the light/dark theme and the Public/Operator sidebar groups, plus a regression pass over the iteration_4 features. New pytest test_routing_drift_api.py: 18/18 pass after I changed the expected status code to the app's INVALID_STATE=409 convention. test_frasberg_api.py: 18/18 pass. test_ops_api.py trends/schedule/oauth subset: 12/12 pass. I did not re-run the Slack-heavy parts of test_extras_api and test_ops_api, so as not to spam the user's real Slack. Theme: light is the default. The toggle switches to dark and back, the choice persists in localStorage and html[data-theme] after reload, and an automated WCAG contrast scan (ratio < 3) of all 14 pages found 0 low-contrast text elements in either theme. Charts, dialogs, toasts and pills render correctly in both themes. Routing dialog: cancel, invalid ID (rejected, dialog stays open), uppercase conversion, save member + own webhook (badge shows @member + own channel), prefill, Send test, Remove own channel and clear all worked. Alerts UI shows 'Drift · fras_val_003' (warning) and 'Breach · fras_val_008' (critical) with alert-value-<id>; only the critical row has an Ack button, and acking it worked. The delivery log shows 003 'delivered HTTP 200' and, after I re-fired 008 once, 'pagerduty dry_run · slack HTTP 200'. Nudge resend entries carry target and mention. Mobile nav chips work at 390px with no horizontal overflow. Real Slack messages caused by testing: 1 (008 re-fire) + 3 (one nudge resend). Routing tests used a fake hooks.slack.com own-channel webhook (HTTP 404), so they posted nothing real.

minor.issue: Does not check that vid exists. An unknown/garbage vid still posts a real Slack message to the main channel ('routing test for *<anything>*'). The PUT endpoint does check this; add the same all_validators() check here.
Returns 409 INVALID_STATE 'Validator not found'. This matches the app's convention, but 404 would be the semantically correct code.
Does not delete the db.validator_routing doc. Re-registering the same validatorId silently inherits the old mention and own-channel webhook.

An unacked breach alert re-posts to the real Slack (with @mention) every escalationMinutes (15) indefinitely, because drift breaches are long-lived. This works as designed but can be noisy. I acked ValidatorDrift_fras_val_008 to stop the re-posts during testing; consider a max-escalations cap.

ui_bugs.issue: An invalid member ID shows a raw pydantic JSON dump in the toast ('[{"type":"string_pattern_mismatch","loc":["body","slackMemberId"]...'). Show a friendly message or validate on the client before saving.
The long value text for the breach row (fras_val_008: uptime, votes, missed) is truncated with no title/tooltip, so the full value can't be read in the UI.

issues: Mobile nav chips have no data-testid attributes

design_issues.screen: Alerts quiet hours / Audit archive schedule
issues: Native <input type=time> (browser default picker) is used
No `color-scheme: dark` set under [data-theme=dark], so native controls and their icons stay light-styled and the clock icon has low contrast in dark mode
Content is capped at max-w-[1440px] and left-aligned, leaving a large empty right gutter (~220px) on wide screens. Consider mx-auto.

ui/sonner.jsx calls next-themes useTheme() with no next-themes provider, so the sonner theme is always 'system'. It looks fine thanks to the class overrides, but it should read theme from kit's useTheme.

action_items: Validate vid in POST /console/fleet/{vid}/routing/test (prevents real Slack posts for nonexistent validators)
Show a readable validation message in RoutingDialog instead of raw pydantic JSON
Optional: add color-scheme: dark for the dark theme, data-testid on mobile nav chips, and a cap on drift escalations
critical_code_review_comments: ops.routing_test lacks the existence check that routing_put has
extras.routing_for: mid.startswith('S') -> <!subteam^S..> is correct, and W/U -> <@..> is correct
Old nudge docs (pre-iteration) lack target/mention; the UI handles this fine
fleet_trends('7d') aggregation runs on every GET /console/alerts and every dispatch (60s). Acceptable now, but consider caching.

success_rate.backend: 100% (48/48 executed; 4 minor issues from code review)

seed_data_creation: None. All routing set during tests was reset to null (validator_routing docs for 003/004/005/009 exist with null values). Deleted alert_state for ValidatorDrift_fras_val_008 once, so it re-fired (delivered 'pagerduty dry_run · slack HTTP 200'), then acked it via the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_routing_drift_api.py -n0 -p no:cacheprovider. The file sends about 4 real Slack messages (an 008 re-dispatch plus one nudge resend for epoch 1000), so avoid re-running it often. Routing tests use the fake hook https://hooks.slack.com/services/TTEST0000/BTEST0000/notarealtoken (returns HTTP 404, nothing posted). The real main webhook is still configured (slackConfigured=true). ValidatorDrift_fras_val_008 is acked; 003 is firing as a warning. Container clock is 2026-10-21. The browser_automation tool breaks on triple-quoted strings and '\n' escapes; use chr(10).join for JS.
